card_reads.read: Ranks #1 in our power figure blend; model 37% vs 20% morning-line implied (+16.5 pts)
card_reads.shape: Nobody is clearly entitled to the lead going five furlongs on turf, which over a sprint usually means an honest pace rather than a meltdown, and a race run close to the figures. Only one has shown genuine early speed, and without company it may get away with a softer lead than the figures suggest. No pace adjustment applied.

card_reads.read: Our top-rated horse in a $10,000 claimer at a mile on dirt. Three of them want the lead. The edge is real but sits under our bet line at 3 points. We make the favourite, #3 THERESASILVERLININ, 17% against the board's 29%, shorter than we think it should be. Our own top-rated is #6 LOVE OUR FAMILY. We are not betting the race; take it as an opinion, not a play.
card_reads.shape: Three horses are entitled to the early lead. Honest early fractions over this trip usually means the leaders are cooked turning for home. Our number credits #1 Makenarita and #6 Love Our Family for it.
